s5.note: Pristine blind test (blind/rei-ayanami.test.ts) run UNMODIFIED vs driver override: 9 passed / 1 FAILED / 2 skipped (12 total). The 1 FAILURE is a BLIND-TEST ASSERTION BUG ruled RECON_ERROR by the binding judge: the blind asserted removing rei's S1B 112.37% rider leaves teammate totals byte-identical, but flatDamage riders call skillGauge() so the rider feeds burst gauge — removing it shifts rei's burst timing → team FB cadence → moves crown/liter ~0.02% (helm identical). The rider is pure personal damage but NOT gauge-neutral; prose + formula side with the driver. The 2 skips are documented magnitude GAPs (burst-shield magnitude — no HP pool; S1a elemAdvantage magnitude — the blind used a Fire boss so Rei is unadvantaged and only structure+inertness is pinnable; the driver instead used a Wind boss to make S1a LIVE — convergent). The 9 passing assertions independently corroborate the driver on every line. leakDetected null.

s6.note: Independent prose→override converged with the driver on EVERY load-bearing mechanical decision. skill2 EXACT MATCH: stageEnter{stage:3} → alliesOfElement Fire → casterAtkPct 25.03/10s (the kit's hardest, most-flagged line). burst EXACT MATCH: burstCast Fire [shield 13.44/10s + attackDamagePct 48.02/10s] + enemy flatDamage 990.2. skill1 EXACT MATCH: hitCount100 self elemAdvantageDamagePct 30.23/3s + enemy flatDamage 112.37. NO real divergence. leakDetected null.

s7.note: Binding judge: GO, faithfulness 1.0, discriminationOk true, 0 gotchas. All 7 kit lines FAITHFUL (5) or DOCUMENTED_GAP (2 — the 700.5% shield-damage passive in unmodeled.skill2, and the burst shield's unobservable magnitude as ⚑3). The single S5 RED ruled RECON_ERROR (gauge coupling), not a defect. S6 byte-equivalent on every load-bearing axis. Discrimination holds on every load-bearing line and not by construction: S1a proven three ways (LIVE vs Wind boss, byte-identical GATED vs Iron boss, ungated attackDamagePct counterfactual provably moves the Iron-boss total); S1b/RA5 vs core:true; S2b/RA4 vs generic-allies + atkPct; the helm co-B3 fixture resolves the stageEnter-vs-burstCast triangle in both directions (the judge named it the strongest discriminator in the suite). Fire-rate verified for every FAITHFUL block (proc counts == floor(shots/100), buff applies == burst-cast counts, windows == 180/600 frames).

faithful: S1: Elemental Advantage Attack Damage ▲ 30.23% for 3 sec (elemAdvantageDamagePct, hitCount 100 → self; engine-gated on real Fire-vs-Wind advantage — inert vs a neutral boss)

flags: ⚑1 elemAdvantageDamagePct 30.23 pays out ONLY under real Fire advantage (BEATS[Fire]=Wind) — inert on the neutral scope-lock boss; confirm the graded boss element before reading her board number.

⚑2 CADENCE TUPLE (measurement-gated): the hitCount-100 proc cadence of both skill1 lines depends on MG fire rate; reloadFrames 171 is unverified datamine. Estimate = engine MG wind-up ladder + full-spin (measured constants) + datamined reloadFrames 171. Recipe: focused solo video — rounds/min, reload gap, per-100-hit proc counter deltas.

⚑3 burst shield (13.44% caster Max HP, 10s) is event-only: no HP pool modeled in v1 and no shield-synergy consumer in the comp, so its magnitude is unobservable end-to-end and asserted nowhere; correctness rests on structural inspection until a shield-consuming teammate exists.

⚑ SAME-MODEL RESIDUAL (binding judge): S2b's insistence on an explicit noFb:true for the 990.2% nuke was correctly overridden by the driver on the basis of the engine's structural burst-cast FB exemption — the test verifies the OBSERVABLE (nukes.filter(fbMajorApplied) === []) rather than the flag, which is stronger; an owner who ever changes burst-cast ordering should re-read that assertion. All magnitudes are literal blablalink kit text (DATAMINED, out of scope); the only always-⚑ quantity in play is the MG cadence tuple (⚑2), which lives in base stats rather than any kit line.
